subcommands.name: send-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Pushes an SSH public key to the specified EC2 instance for use by the specified user.

options.description: The ID of the EC2 instance

options.name: --instance-os-user
options.description: The OS user on the EC2 instance for whom the key can be used to authenticate

options.description: The Availability Zone in which the EC2 instance was launched
